name: Charros IV
description: Charros IV was a planet in the Mid Rim Territories' Numesira sector. It was the site of the Xi Char Cathedral factories, where members of the Xi Charrian species produced the Vulture-class starfighter "vulture droid." During the Galactic Civil War, the Rebel Alliance was forced to retreat from Charros IV, expecting the Galactic Empire to soon retake the world.
